finalists.label: Testicular cancer with adrenal metastasis
finalists.why: It accounts for both testicular and adrenal findings.

finalists.label: Testicular cancer

finalists.label: Metastatic cancer
finalists.why: It provides a plausible mechanism for the adrenal findings.

finalists.label: Primary adrenal lymphoma
finalists.why: It is a possible explanation for the adrenal findings, despite lacking evidence.

frontier_selector.why: The lack of uptake in the adrenal glands on the 18 FDG PET/CT makes testicular cancer with adrenal metastasis less likely.
